newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
National Gem and Jewelry Authority to pour 240 million ruppees into scheme to develop gem and jewelry industry zone.
Criminal Investigations Department grills opposition United National Party chief Ranil Wickremesinghe on 1988-90 political violence and human rights violations.
More than 14,000 nurses poised to mount islandwide strike on November 14 to demand back pay.
